description:
We are seeking a highly motivated Software Engineer to join our Critical Communication Systems development team in Lincoln, Nebraska.
 In this role, you will design, develop, and maintain modern desktop applications used by public safety dispatch centers and mission-critical communication environments. You will work closely with software engineers, product managers, UX designers, and customers to deliver reliable, high-performance solutions that support emergency communications and critical decision-making.
 We are looking for engineers who are inspired by meaningful work and who are excited by the opportunity to build reliable product that supports life-safety operations and critical decision making.
 Job Scope: 
 As a Software Engineer at Keenfinity, you will collaborate with a dedicated team in researching, designing, developing, and testing software applications and solutions for our IP Dispatch Console and RTS Intercom products. Our Research and Development function prioritizes customer satisfaction, product quality, technological advancements, and timely market delivery.
 If you are seeking a fulfilling full-time role as a Software Engineer that offers engaging and intricate projects while making a meaningful impact on safeguarding and preserving lives, we invite you to join our esteemed engineering team at Keenfinity.
 Analytical skills and effective communication are essential for this role, along with active listening and a willingness to learn from others. As we operate in a fast-paced industry, the ability to work efficiently under pressure, with some autonomy, and consistently deliver high-quality results is crucial.
 Why Join Us 
 Work in an Agile development environment to build products that help protect lives and property.
 Use modern technologies including Electron, React, TypeScript, and cloud-connected solutions.
 Own meaningful features and see your impact on real-world operations.
 Take pride in developing reliable software that people depend on during critical situations.
 Thrive in a collaborative environment and enjoy working across disciplines to deliver outstanding products.
 Core Responsibilities 
 Design and develop Electron-based desktop applications using React and TypeScript.
 Build intuitive, responsive, and scalable user interfaces.
 Implement real-time communications and data visualization capabilities.
 Develop and maintain REST API and WebSocket integrations.
 Collaborate with cross-functional teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
 Participate in architecture discussions, code reviews, and technical design decisions.
 Create automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
 Troubleshoot and resolve software defects, performance issues, and customer-reported problems.
 Contribute to the continuous improvement of software quality, development processes, and engineering practices.
 Support deployment, maintenance, and enhancement of existing product lines.
 
 Required Skills 
 Strong experience with React, TypeScript, and modern JavaScript.
 Experience developing Electron-based desktop applications.
 Knowledge of Electron architecture including IPC, renderer, and main processes.
 Experience with REST APIs, asynchronous programming, and Git.
 Understanding software architecture, design patterns, and Agile development.
 Preferred Skills 
 Experience with Redux, Zustand, or React Query.
 Experience with WebSockets, real-time systems, or event-driven architecture.
 Knowledge of public safety, dispatch, telecommunications, VoIP, radio, GIS, or situational awareness systems.
 Experience with Azure, C#, .NET, or C++.
 Who You Are 
 •   Motivated by solving meaningful real-world problems.
 •   Inspired by technology that supports first responders and public safety professionals.
 •   Self-driven, curious, collaborative, and committed to continuous learning.
 Education Required 
 B.S. degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or equivalent.

 The U.S. base salary range for this full-time position is $85,000-$115,000 per year. Within the range, individual pay is determined based on several factors, including, but not limited to, work experience and job knowledge, complexity of the role, job location, etc.
 In addition to base salary, full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group's (US) Health and Welfare Benefit Plans—including medical, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance—as well as the company’s 401(k) plan, subject to the terms and conditions of the respective plan documents. Full-time employees are eligible to participate in Keenfinity Group’s paid time off and sick leave programs in accordance with applicable policies. 
 Reasonable accommodations may be made, to the extent they do not pose an undue hardship, to enable qualified individuals with covered disabilities to perform essential functions.
 Indefinite U.S. work authorized individuals only. Future sponsorship for work authorization is not available.
 All of your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
 At Keenfinity we don’t just build innovative solutions — we shape a smarter, more connected world through technology.  We value different backgrounds, ideas, and experiences and we’re committed to growing, learning, and celebrating success as one team. Everyone is welcome here — we foster an environment where everyone is respected, valued, and encouraged to be their authentic self. 
 Keenfinity is an equal opportunity employer, offering equal opportunities for all. We welcome applications from people with disabilities and can offer support, if needed. When everyone has a chance to contribute, we all do better.
